title: Understanding the Wird
intro_html: The Wird is your personal daily practice of dhikr, the remembrance of Allah, done alone, usually once in the morning and once in the evening. It’s not something you assemble yourself: each fiqir receives their Wird individually, by idhn (spiritual permission) from the living Shaykh, matched to where they are on the path. As you progress, further elements may be added.
list_items: Find a quiet moment, ideally after Fajr and after Maghrib/Isha
Face the qibla if you're able to
Recite exactly what you were given, no more and no less, unless instructed otherwise
Consistency matters more than length. A small Wird done daily outweighs a long one done rarely
Haven't received your Wird yet? Speak to one of the brothers after Dhikr
